mechanics.claim: Annie generates a stack whenever she hits an enemy with Disintegrate or casts her other abilities.
mechanics.quote: generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Pyromania'' whenever she hits an enemy with ''{{ai|Disintegrate|Annie}}'' or casts her other {{tip|abilities}}

mechanics.claim: At maximum stacks she gains Energized, empowering her next cast of Disintegrate, Incinerate, or Summon: Tibbers to consume all stacks and stun.
mechanics.quote: empowers her next cast of ''{{ai|Disintegrate|Annie}}'', ''{{ai|Incinerate|Annie}}'', or ''{{ai|Summon: Tibbers|Annie}}'' to consume all ''Pyromania'' stacks to {{tip|stun}} enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Stacks are gained even if the ability is blocked by spell shield.
mechanics.quote: Stacks are gained even if the ability is blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}.

mechanics.claim: The stun applies to the first empowered ability that lands, e.g. Incinerate if it lands before Disintegrate.
mechanics.quote: The stun applies to the first ability that lands when the stun is available.

mechanics.claim: Annie gains maximum stacks when the game starts and upon respawning, and loses Energized and all stacks upon death.
mechanics.quote: gains maximum stacks of ''Pyromania'' when the game starts and upon [[death|respawning]]. She will lose ''Energized'' and all ''Pyromania'' stacks upon [[death]]
